summary.intent: Complete phase 43 (fuse-write-durability) by running a CodeRabbit review, cross-checking and fixing all 8 critical findings, applying a /simplify pass, capturing deferred follow-ups as todos, and shipping PR #487 — then improve codecov signal by extracting testable logic from sync/mod.rs and wiring Rust crates into coverage reporting.
summary.outcome: PR #487 opened for feat(fuse): durable write journal with crash-recovery replay; all 8 review criticals verified fixed (CR-03 TEE-key fallback fully closed across all 8 IPNS-key journal wrap sites, CR-04 mutation ordering deferred past journal fsync on both fuser and winfsp paths); 3 /simplify cleanups applied; 6 deferred refactor todos captured; sync/mod.rs edge-trigger logic extracted into a pure testable bridge with 8 passing unit tests; Rust crate coverage wired into codecov via a new rust flag.

repo: Phase 43 is branch feat/fuse-write-durability; the GSD slug is 43-fuse-write-durability.
After `gh pr create`, github-actions[bot] immediately pushes a chore(release) commit to the PR branch — the next local push will be rejected until you `git fetch` + rebase onto it.
The winfsp codebase path cannot be compiled locally on macOS; the winfsp CI gate is the first real compile for any Windows-path edits.
CI runs `cargo check/test --workspace` for both `--features winfsp` and `--features fuse` (ci.yml:557–605) but has no cargo fmt or clippy gate.
The entire repo is not rustfmt-styled; running `cargo fmt` would reformat unrelated code — do not run it as a cleanup step.
codecov.yml patch and desktop flags are both `informational: true` — low patch coverage does not block merge.

`crates/fuse` and `crates/sdk` were invisible to codecov; the existing `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` job already generates full workspace coverage but only uploaded it under the `desktop` flag whose path filter discards the crates lines.
tray/status.rs is already 100% covered because it separates pure status mapping from OS calls — the same pattern was applied to extract the sync edge-trigger logic.

The journal dir path `<data_local_dir>/cipherbox/cb-journal` and the magic retry count 5 are triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, and commands/sync.rs — a known footgun where sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at the same dir.
JournalEntry uses an inconsistent sentinel pattern: parent_ipns_key_hex uses empty-string sentinel while file_ipns_key_hex already uses Option<String>.

code.finding: CR-03 residual: child-key journal wrap fell back to encrypted_ipns_for_tee (TEE-wrapped) on wrap_key failure — wrong key in the user-key field. Fixed to warn + journal String::new() so replay parks rather than attempting to replay with the wrong key.

CR-03 residual (winfsp path): same TEE-key fallback as fuser plus `wrap_key` used at lines 148/152/886 while the rest of the file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` — fixed to ecies::wrap_key uniformly and warn+park fallback.

CR-04: inode.kind mutation (~765), pending_content assignment (~782), and queue_publish (~794) all occurred before journal.put (~874). A journal failure left in-memory state mutated with EIO already sent to the OS. Fixed by deferring all three mutations to after the journal fsync commit point.
Parent IPNS key wrap failure was swallowed via .ok() → empty key with no log, breaking replay publish. Now warns and journals empty string (replay parks).
sort_by_key used a duplicated per-variant match on created_at_ms across two sort sites. Extracted JournalOp::created_at_ms() accessor to collapse both.
Dead journal_entry_id field was computed, stored in UploadSpawnParams, destructured, and immediately let _-suppressed. Removed entirely.

Edge-trigger write-parked notification logic (notify only when failed > prev, reset on Idle) was inlined and untested. Extracted into pure bridge_status function with 8 unit tests covering spam-regression cases.

First-publish detection keys off e.to_lowercase().contains("not found") from coordinator.resolve_sequence — a reworded error silently flips the seq-0 branch. Should return Result<Option<u64>> or a typed NotFound variant (deferred).

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI can be scoped to a phase diff using the merge-base commit as the base, avoiding reviewing unrelated historical commits.

Parallel agent dispatch for cross-checking N independent review findings against current code is faster and more reliable than sequential reads — each agent is read-only and returns a verdict+evidence tuple.
/simplify and /code-review are separate passes: code-review hunts bugs, simplify does reuse/efficiency/altitude cleanups only. Both should be run before shipping.
When a /simplify finding requires a new crate dependency to implement cleanly, defer it — adding deps is not a cleanup-pass-sized change.
Cargo check on the fuser crate is a fast local proxy for winfsp correctness when edits are structurally symmetric; CI is still the definitive winfsp compile gate.
The GSD ship workflow blocks on verification status != passed — record UAT results in VERIFICATION.md before running /gsd:ship.
After a 1Password SSH signer failure ('failed to fill whole buffer'), staged changes are preserved — only the signing step failed. Restarting 1Password recovers it without needing to re-stage.

friction: 1Password SSH signer failed twice with 'failed to fill whole buffer' error — required a full 1Password app restart to recover; the second failure attempt wedged silently (exit 0 but commit not written).

After `gh pr create`, github-actions[bot] immediately pushed a chore(release) commit to the branch, causing the subsequent `docs(43): ship phase 43` push to be rejected with a non-fast-forward error — required fetch + rebase.
Transient GitHub connectivity failure (port 443 timeout after 75s) during push — required retry.
winfsp code cannot be compiled locally on macOS; CR-04 Windows path edits had to be verified by inspection rather than `cargo check`, increasing review effort.
Phase 43 verification was stuck at `human_needed` despite UAT being complete — the `/gsd:ship` workflow blocked until VERIFICATION.md was manually updated to reflect the completed UAT.

The 3-platform UAT results for journal survival, park notification, mkdir orphan, and ciphertext-only check were not recorded in VERIFICATION.md during the verify pass, requiring a corrective commit at ship time.
phase 42 commits (22 total) appeared in the PR commit list because the branch predates the squash PR #485, creating noise — resolved by noting squash-merge, but the commit list looks polluted.
open_items: Consolidate duplicated fuser and winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods in crates/fuse/src/lib.rs — highest-value deferred refactor (~150 lines of drifting near-identical code); security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved.

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing IPNS journal keys with Option<String> uniformly plus a wrap_ipns_key_for_journal helper — parent_ipns_key_hex and file_ipns_key_hex are currently inconsistent.
Extract shared journal-dir path and DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES constant — triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, commands/sync.rs; clean fix needs `dirs` dep in crates/sdk.
Have replay_upload_entry delegate to operations::publish_file_metadata and extract a shared cas_publish_parent helper — replay currently re-inlines ~70+40 lines of publish logic.

Memoize resolve_folder_key during replay_for_vault using a HashMap<ipns_name, folder_key> — currently re-walks vault tree from root per entry, causing super-linear replay latency when multiple entries share a parent.
Replace string-matching on 'not found' in replay first-publish detection with a typed Result<Option<u64>> or NotFound variant from coordinator.resolve_sequence.
winfsp CI gate is the first real compile of the CR-03/CR-04/simplify winfsp edits — watch the Lint/E2E checks on PR #487 specifically for winfsp build failures.
CR-04 inode rollback is partially deferred by design on winfsp: WinFsp Cleanup returns VOID so EIO cannot be signaled — documented in code but a phantom-publish risk remains.
No unit test asserts the CR-04 invariant 'prepare failure leaves no partial state' — hard to force journal.put failure in a test but worth adding.
Rust crates (fuse/sdk) codecov wiring commit was in-flight at end of session — confirm push landed and that the new rust flag appears in next PR coverage report.
